g.text: Remove the transaction from the HashTable,
both BSTs, and the doubly linked list
Subtract it from the corresponding income or expense total
Restore the transaction to the HashTable,
both BSTs, and the doubly linked list
Restore the corresponding income or expense total
Reinsert the transaction into every index
Restore the corresponding income or expense total
Remove the transaction from every index again
Subtract it from the corresponding income or expense total
The current update operation stores old_values in the action
but does not store new_values. With the current action data,
redoing an update may not restore the modified values.
